lessons.key: surviving_mutant::before relying on a custom test setup aftereach hook cleanup storage clearing verify it is actually load bearing by checking whether the testing library s own built in defaults already provide the same guarantee since a call that only duplicates a library default is unfalsifiable by the suite
lessons.text: Before relying on a custom test-setup afterEach hook (cleanup, storage clearing), verify it is actually load-bearing by checking whether the testing library's own built-in defaults already provide the same guarantee, since a call that only duplicates a library default is unfalsifiable by the suite.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a config flag whose only effect is on an edge case with no committed test file e g exit code on empty suite cannot be regression tested by the repo s own gate document it as manually verified only instead of assuming future changes to it will be caught
lessons.text: A config flag whose only effect is on an edge case with no committed test file (e.g. exit-code-on-empty-suite) cannot be regression-tested by the repo's own gate; document it as manually-verified-only instead of assuming future changes to it will be caught.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec edge case is a css layout claim untestable in jsdom e g wrapping content computed height name the test after what it actually asserts class presence instead of the layout outcome or note the jsdom limitation in a comment
lessons.text: When a spec edge case is a CSS/layout claim untestable in jsdom (e.g. wrapping content, computed height), name the test after what it actually asserts (class presence) instead of the layout outcome, or note the jsdom limitation in a comment.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec edge case says every empty list gets an empty state message apply it to every list rendering call site in the diff not just the ones with an existing precedent to copy
lessons.text: When a spec edge case says 'every empty list gets an empty-state message,' apply it to every list-rendering call site in the diff, not just the ones with an existing precedent to copy.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a task s done when claims a specific contrast ratio verify it against every active color scheme variant light and dark media queries not just the one visually checked during implementation
lessons.text: When a task's Done-when claims a specific contrast ratio, verify it against every active color-scheme variant (light and dark media queries), not just the one visually checked during implementation.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a service sanitizes a dangling foreign key like field before deriving computed values add a direct test asserting the sanitized field s computed output for the dangling reference case not just for the null valid cases
lessons.text: When a service sanitizes a dangling/foreign-key-like field before deriving computed values, add a direct test asserting the sanitized-field's computed output for the dangling-reference case, not just for the null/valid cases.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when an ac requires an unchanged element to remain readable add a classname assertion for it not just a text presence assertion symmetric elements e g two empty state messages fixed by the same feature can end up with asymmetric test coverage
lessons.text: When an AC requires an unchanged element to remain readable, add a className assertion for it, not just a text-presence assertion — symmetric elements (e.g. two empty-state messages fixed by the same feature) can end up with asymmetric test coverage.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec ac names a visual attribute e g a colour swatch assert that attribute s class value directly in the test not just the presence of adjacent text
lessons.text: When a spec AC names a visual attribute (e.g. a colour swatch), assert that attribute's class/value directly in the test, not just the presence of adjacent text.

lessons.key: ac_gap::write one test per listed spec edge case even when the underlying implementation is a static class already covered by another test an untested static class is still an unverified requirement
lessons.text: Write one test per listed spec Edge Case, even when the underlying implementation is a static class already covered by another test — an untested static class is still an unverified requirement.
evidence: spec.md Edge Cases (hover/focus, long-title truncation) — no test in src/pages/__tests__/Calendar.test.jsx (testing)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec edge case names a specific field as the long value example assert the wrap related class on that exact field s element not on a nearby sibling field that happens to lengthen too
lessons.text: When a spec edge case names a specific field as the long-value example, assert the wrap-related class on that exact field's element, not on a nearby sibling field that happens to lengthen too.
evidence: spec.md Edge Cases (long value wraps); Home.test.jsx:721-741 (dashboard)

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when a spec edge case describes two sibling components with differing content sizes behaving identically add a test that renders both together and directly compares their computed properties not just a test that the shared behavior holds in isolation for each
lessons.text: When a spec edge case describes two sibling components with differing content sizes behaving identically, add a test that renders both together and directly compares their computed properties, not just a test that the shared behavior holds in isolation for each.
evidence: spec.md Edge Cases (uneven leader entry counts fill row height); Home.test.jsx (no direct pairing test) (dashboard)

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when one component has its own defensive fallback for an invalid id e g tabs jsx falling back to the first tab a caller s separate allow list guard for the same value needs its own test that can t be satisfied by the child s fallback alone
lessons.text: When one component has its own defensive fallback for an invalid id (e.g. Tabs.jsx falling back to the first tab), a caller's separate allow-list guard for the same value needs its own test that can't be satisfied by the child's fallback alone.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::when migrating multiple files to a shared ui primitive add one assertion per migrated file confirming its own variant class wiring not just tests for the shared primitive itself
lessons.text: When migrating multiple files to a shared UI primitive, add one assertion per migrated file confirming its own variant/class wiring, not just tests for the shared primitive itself.
